paraphrase.proposes: This track moves every AI feature to OpenRouter through the official @openrouter/sdk package in packages/ai-tutoring. Each AI role reads its model from its own environment variable, with no default model; a missing setting fails closed. The track adds a structured-output helper with Zod schemas, moves the BM2 spreadsheet feedback and the BM2 teacher error summary to it, and removes the OpenAI code paths and the unused ai-interpretation.ts module.
paraphrase.current_system: packages/ai-tutoring calls the OpenRouter chat endpoint with plain fetch, reads the model from OPENROUTER_MODEL with a default of openrouter/free, and applies its own retry, timeout, and abort logic. The IM3 and BM2 lesson chatbots resolve a provider from the environment and return HTTP 503 when the key is missing. BM2 spreadsheet feedback asks for JSON only and parses it with JSON.parse and a Zod schema. The BM2 teacher error summary calls OpenAI directly through an injected provider function in packages/practice-core. No UI calls the teacher summary route, and only a test imports ai-interpretation.ts.
